claim: PICARD constrains autoregressive decoding via incremental parsing, rejecting inadmissible tokens at each step to find valid SQL output sequences.
quote: PICARD helps to find valid output sequences by rejecting inadmissible tokens at each decoding step. ... checking, accepting, and rejecting of tokens and token sequences is achieved through parsing

claim: PICARD lifts T5-3B on Spider dev from 71.5% to 75.5% exact-set match and from 74.4% to 79.3% execution accuracy, reaching 75.1% execution accuracy on test.
quote: Development Set: Exact-set Match Accuracy 75.5%, Execution Accuracy 79.3%. Test Set: ... Execution Accuracy 75.1%. ... without PICARD ... 71.5% exact-set match and 74.4% execution accuracy

claim: DIN-SQL adds a human-written self-correction module that revises initially generated SQL, achieving 85.3 execution accuracy on the Spider test set.
quote: DIN-SQL designs a human-written self-correction guideline and revises all the initially generated SQLs according to this guideline ... achieving execution accuracy of 85.3 on the Spider test set

claim: On Spider dev, DIN-SQL self-correction adds ~1.73 points (78.62% to 80.35%), while MAGIC's auto-generated guideline from failure analysis reaches 85.66% execution accuracy.
quote: DIN-SQL achieves 78.62% execution accuracy on Spider's development set without self-correction. With self-correction ... 80.35% ... MAGIC achieves 85.66% execution accuracy on Spider

claim: MAC-SQL's Refiner executes candidate SQL, captures execution-error feedback, and re-prompts to repair queries, helping reach 59.59% on BIRD test and 86.75% on Spider dev.
quote: the Refiner (for validating and refining defective SQL queries) ... employs an external tool for SQL execution, obtains feedback, and refines erroneous SQL ... 59.59% on the BIRD test set and 86.75% on the Spider development set

claim: CSC-SQL merges self-consistency and self-correction by feeding the two most frequent sampled SQLs into a merge-revision model, reaching 73.67% on BIRD private test (32B).
quote: CSC selects the two most frequently occurring outputs from parallel sampling and feeds them into a merge revision model for correction ... BIRD Private Test Set: 32B model 73.67% execution accuracy

claim: Execution-guided decoding excludes faulty partial programs by conditioning on partial execution, reaching 83.8% execution accuracy on WikiSQL.
quote: Execution guidance ... detecting and excluding faulty programs during the decoding procedure by conditioning on the execution of partially generated program ... state-of-the-art execution accuracy of 83.8% on WikiSQL

claim: A 2026 single-agent self-refinement + ensemble (weighted majority) voting pipeline (SSEV) reaches 85.5%/86.4% on Spider dev/test and 66.3% on BIRD-dev without ground-truth data.
quote: Single-Agent Self-Refinement with Ensemble Voting (SSEV) ... Spider 1.0-Dev: 85.5% ... Spider 1.0-Test: 86.4% ... BIRD-Dev: 66.3% ... integrates Weighted Majority Voting (WMV) and its randomized variant
